statement_summary: One group program aligned to CSF 2.0 covering IT and OT
Annual SP 800-30 risk analysis per division with roll-up; feeds the food defense vulnerability assessment
Risk acceptance authority by level; food safety risks at High must be treated
Division supplements may not weaken group policy; re-align within 90 days; annual attestation
Divisions document and confirm inheritance of common controls
No security terms, no access; annual assurance review for critical suppliers
Annual independent assessment of common controls and division samples
Retention of security records for 6 years; food safety records per the governing rule
AI systems registered and approved under the Group AI Standard
FSQA sign-off on OT changes with HACCP and food defense decisions
Unique identities; named HMI sign-in by 2027-06-30
Least privilege; two-person formulation approval; separate recipe library administration
MFA for all IT access and for remote, administrator, and OT engineering access
Service accounts owned, governed, and vaulted in PAM
Termination within 4 hours; agency accounts expire automatically
Just-in-time privileged access with session recording
OT remote and vendor access only through SYS-G5; no always-on VPNs or modems
External identities: MFA for customers and 3PL users; named telematics users
Default credentials changed before any device connects
Report suspected incidents to the SOC within 1 hour
One group severity scale and playbooks
Food safety first: FSQA engaged and affected product held
Record discovery, last trusted record, and determination dates
Notification matrix owned by counsel; counsel approves external notices
Disclosure committee within 24 hours; Form 8-K Item 1.05 within 4 business days of materiality
Ransom decisions with board approval and an OFAC check
Annual cross-division exercise with product, card, and materiality decisions
Lessons learned within 30 days; update HACCP and food defense plans as needed
Restart only after formulations and PLC programs are verified
Payment card incident steps with the acquirer
Four classes; food defense plans and formulations are Restricted
Encryption of Restricted data; no stored cardholder data; P2PE or hosted fields
Food defense plans and formulations in restricted libraries
Food safety records attributed, protected, and retained with audit trails on
3PL customer data isolated per customer; temperature history append-only
Immutable or offline backups apart from production; quarterly restore tests
No Restricted data in unapproved AI tools
Annual acknowledgment of this policy and the division supplement
Annual awareness training; food defense awareness before first shift at Plant 6
Role-based training before access
No personal devices or unscanned media in OT or on payment terminals
AI and camera images only for approved purposes; no worker evaluation or shopper identification
